title: Folder structure
recommendation: One folder per genre or vibe, never more than two levels deep.
steps: Music / House, Music / Techno, Music / Jungle …
Keep acapellas in their own folder.
Move and rename files before importing to rekordbox, not after.

title: Local folders → rekordbox
recommendation: Import your whole music folder once, then only re-import when you add tracks.
steps: Find your music folder in rekordbox's file browser.
Right-click it and choose Import Folder.
Build playlists from your genre folders.

title: rekordbox → USB
recommendation: Export playlists to the USB, not the whole library.
steps: Format the USB as FAT32 or exFAT (check your player's manual).
Plug it in; it appears under Devices in rekordbox.
Eject it from rekordbox before pulling it out.

title: Acapellas you can beatmatch
recommendation: Give every acapella a count-in so it lands on the downbeat first time.
steps: Acapella prep: drop the file in.
Lock the grid at the chorus: click four beats, loop them, check the click.
Click where the vocal comes in, then export.

title: Spotify playlists from folders
recommendation: One folder, one Spotify playlist. Always preview before you sync.
steps: Link Spotify with the setup guide on the Spotify sync page.
